C1427.title: Sybil Attack Application in the P2P Botnet Storm
C1427.summary: Defenders deploy Sybil nodes to counter the Storm P2P botnet. An attacker fabricates multiple Sybil nodes from a single malicious entity, placing them in the query paths of legitimate nodes to disrupt or block the botnet's C&C communication, employing strategies such as index poisoning and activity monitoring.

references.title: What Is a Sybil Attack - Tencent Cloud Developer Community
